blocks.title: Claiming your presence
blocks.instruction: Stand with both feet grounded. Imagine entering the room where you most belong. Let the body find its posture before the mind names it.
items: One slow breath in. Roll the shoulders back.
Lift the crown of the head, gently.
Picture the room. See who is there.
Notice your pace, your voice, your attention.
Let the body hold that posture for a few breaths.

prompts.text: When are you most naturally yourself?
What changes in your pace, voice, gaze, and attention?
Name the quality that appears when I stop performing: …

blocks.closing: Carry the posture, not the pose.
